mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( USER_NO, ADMIN_NO, STATUS, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{adminNo}, 'OPEN', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_NO, USER_NO, ADMIN_NO, STATUS, LAST_MESSAGE, LAST_MESSAGE_DATE, CREATED_DATE, CLOSED_DATE FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND STATUS = 'OPEN' ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT ROOM_NO, USER_NO, ADMIN_NO, STATUS, LAST_MESSAGE, LAST_MESSAGE_DATE, CREATED_DATE, CLOSED_DATE FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo}
SELECT ROOM_NO, USER_NO, ADMIN_NO, STATUS, LAST_MESSAGE, LAST_MESSAGE_DATE, CREATED_DATE, CLOSED_DATE FROM CHAT_ROOM ORDER BY LAST_MESSAGE_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, CREATED_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET LAST_MESSAGE = #{lastMessage}, LAST_MESSAGE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo}
UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', CLOSED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE ( ROOM_NO, SENDER_NO, MESSAGE_CONTENT, READ_YN, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{roomNo}, #{senderNo}, #{messageContent}, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_NO, ROOM_NO, SENDER_NO, MESSAGE_CONTENT, READ_YN, CREATED_DATE FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ASC, MESSAGE_NO ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_MESSAGE SET READ_YN = 'Y' WHERE ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} AND READ_YN = 'N'
